title: ResearchStudio-Reel: Automate the Last Mile of Research from Paper to Poster, Video, and Blog
pages: ResearchStudio-Reel: Automate the Last Mile of Research from Paper to Poster, Video, and Blog
The last mile of research is a separate layer, prepared in the days after acceptance, and three gaps remain open
Prior work is organized by output type; contracts differ in editability, and VLM scores are mostly used for evaluation, not as release gates
The answer: a native-editable workspace of five skills — one shared extractor, three editable generators, one convergence layer
Paper2Assets reads the PDF once and emits one bundle every generator consumes verbatim; figure cleanup runs once
Paper2Poster composes on four orthogonal axes, fills the page with a measured loop, and exports native PowerPoint shapes
The fill loop is discrete: five verdict bands, one section edited per round, termination as a categorical fixed point
Paper2Video plans duration before rendering, anchors narration to visible objects, and gates an editable deck plus two MP4s
Paper2Blog writes the Chinese and English articles separately from one evidence map, then gates the Word files on layout
Paper2Reel is a presentation surface, not a fourth summary: one alignment sidecar makes four artifacts views of one section
Best automated system on all three aesthetic sub-criteria (3.56 vs the authors' 3.03) and on two of three information sub-criteria
The PaperQuiz ordering nearly reverses the aesthetic ordering: denser posters answer more; the fill loop packs to a target density
With the skill, prompt, and pipeline fixed, five configurations each produce a full page differing in figure choice, density, and accent
A full four-artifact bundle takes about 89 minutes of stage time and 2.6M input / 276K output tokens per paper
Three contexts span the dissemination spectrum on one pipeline: a camera-ready week, a lab's intake, a course's weekly packs
Five failure modes recur in end-to-end runs; the system is calibrated on ML / CV / NLP venues only; quantitative evaluation covers the poster
Supported: a native-editable, section-aligned workspace with testable gates. Open: reading-and-recall evaluation and bespoke diagrams

pages: 电动车增长的下一站
增量重心已从欧美转向新兴市场,2026–2028 应分级投入,并以 PHEV 打开低渗透市场
2025 年全球电动车销量 2,100 万辆、渗透率 25%,五年增长七倍——电动车已是主流市场,不是利基
2025 年 400 万辆增量中,中国贡献一半,美国转负,中美欧之外的市场增量首次超过欧洲
美国渗透率连续两年停在 10%、销量首次下滑,日本仍在 3%——成熟市场里只有韩国还在起量
欧洲反弹到 28% 靠英国(35%)和德国(30%)拉动,法国两年零增长——进入欧洲要选国家,而不是选大区
东南亚渗透率两年从 8.4% 升到 18%、泰国达 23%,巴西、墨西哥、印度同步起量——新兴市场已经进入加速段
PHEV 已占全球电动车销量的 34%,在中国三年增长 3.4 倍——它是低渗透市场的破冰产品,不是过渡产品
到 2035 年的 3,400 万辆增量中,中国占 38%、欧洲 29%、印度与东南亚合计 12%,美国仅 5%——增量地图与今天的存量地图不同
建议按三级优先级分配 2026–2028 增量投入:中国深耕、欧洲选点、东南亚与拉美抢滩,美国转为守势
2026 年 PHEV 试点东南亚与拉美,2027 年按结果放量并补齐英德 BEV,2028 年再决定是否加码美国
三项风险各有可监测的触发指标:新兴市场增速回落、欧洲政策反复、PHEV 需求提前见顶——它们不构成不行动的理由
请管理层本季度决定三件事:批准三级优先级、批准 PHEV 先行节奏、指定东南亚试点负责人

title: Cloudflare Outage Postmortem, 18 November 2025
pages: A database permissions change, not an attack, stopped Cloudflare's core traffic on 18 November 2025
One feature file doubled in size and a fixed 200-feature limit turned it into a global 5xx event
Six product surfaces failed, and two of them degraded rather than stopped
The same bad file produced errors on the new proxy and silent false positives on the old one
The error rate rose and fell every five minutes until every database node produced the bad file
From the 11:05 access-control change to the first bypass at 13:05
From confidence in the trigger at 13:37 to full restoration at 17:06
Detection took three minutes; identifying the failing module took two hours and fifty-three
A query that filtered on table name but not database name became an unhandled panic in the core proxy
Four conditions had to hold at once, and no single one of them is the cause
Rapid global propagation of internally generated configuration is the condition both 2019 and 2025 share
Three controls limited the damage and are the ones to protect
Four corrective actions are published, and none of them carries an owner, a date, or a verification method
Five questions the published account does not settle
Every figure in this deck traces to one of three published records

title: 什么是 PPT
pages: 什么是 PPT?它不只是几页幻灯片,而是四种东西的叠加
说“PPT”时,我们其实在说五种不同的东西
五种扩展名,一个现代标准
人们要的不是“几页”,是受众身上发生的改变
一份演示,可能同时在完成九种任务
七项属性叠加,才是 PowerPoint 的独特价值
PowerPoint 不该是所有信息任务的默认选择
同一份 deck,在不同阶段扮演不同角色
一页无法同时最优地服务四种传递场景
.pptx 是相互关联部件组成的包
视觉上正确的截图,仍可能结构很差
模板存在,是因为某种东西预计会重复出现
好的 deck,不能只用“视觉精美”来定义
研究并不支持“图片越多越好”
PPT 并不天然等于这八件事
做 PPT 之前,先回答这八个问题
先想清任务,工具才服务沟通
